page.$description: never flat pure grey; optional warm mesh toward #F3F0EB and blooms at 25-35%

$root.$description: card: no border, no shadow (optional ambient 5%)

raised.$description: puffy chip / round button on the page (#F7F8FA, opaque; ADR-0030 §5.2), with color.edge.raised as its top edge and elevation.1; also the glass fallback

nested.$description: filled control, dock tray (= #F0F1F1 on white)

inverse.$description: primary pill, active tab, solid action circle

inverse-pressed.$description: the inverse solid while pressed: bg.fill.inverse one step up the neutral ladder (neutral.950 to 850, OKLab L +0.084), under the same on-inverse text, so a primary pill or circle shows its press without the scale (ADR-0023 §8.4, ADR-0039)

inverse-media.$description: the white solid of visual-dna principle 9 on vivid: Button primary and the active segment when the published material is vivid (ADR-0030 §3.1)

inverse-media-pressed.$description: the white solid over media while pressed: bg.fill.inverse-media one step down the neutral ladder (neutral.0 to 200, OKLab L -0.084), under the same ink (ADR-0039)

on-inverse-pressed.$description: the solid knocked out on an inverse ground, while pressed: text.on-inverse (neutral.0 in light) one step down the neutral ladder (neutral.0 to 200, OKLab L -0.084), under bg.fill.inverse as its label. Button primary and IconButton primary or selected on an inverse surface (ADR-0039 rule 5, ADR-0040 §3.5)

on-accent-pressed.$description: the solid knocked out on the lit tile, while pressed: the tile's ink, text.on-accent, at 88 %, so 12 % of the tile shows through, under bg.fill.accent as its label; relative to text.on-accent because that follows a brand's text-on-accent slot. Button primary and IconButton primary or selected on an accent surface (ADR-0039 rule 5, ADR-0040 §3.5)

accent.$description: the one attention tile; content is ink

success.$description: the dot step at 12%, so a status wash over a map shows the map through it (ADR-0030 §6.1); a tinted element with text over media paints color.bg.page under it (§6.2)

warning.$description: the dot step at 12%, so a status wash over a map shows the map through it (ADR-0030 §6.1); a tinted element with text over media paints color.bg.page under it (§6.2)

critical.$description: the dot step at 12%, so a status wash over a map shows the map through it (ADR-0030 §6.1); a tinted element with text over media paints color.bg.page under it (§6.2)

info.$description: the dot step at 12%, so a status wash over a map shows the map through it (ADR-0030 §6.1); a tinted element with text over media paints color.bg.page under it (§6.2)

tertiary.$description: resolves to the secondary step so 12 px captions pass AA; the DNA's #7E838F is kept as text.dimmed for >= 24 px

dimmed.$description: 3.4:1 on page: trailing digits and units at >= 24 px only

on-inverse-media.$description: ink on the white solid over vivid (bg.fill.inverse-media; ADR-0030 §3.1)

on-accent-secondary.$description: the lit tile's second tone: on-accent at 70% for the secondary, tertiary and dimmed tones of the accent material (ADR-0030 §3.4)

on-vivid.$description: every vivid gradient, the nine reference gradients included, passes ADR-0022 V1/V2

on-glass.$description: white on dark glass; light glass uses on-glass-light (ADR-0022)

on-glass-light.$description: ink on light glass in the light scheme; hierarchy by size, never by alpha (ADR-0022 §3)

on-glass-secondary.$description: secondary tone on dark glass (the glass material) only; chips and cells use on-glass (ADR-0022 §3)

on-glass-tertiary.$description: tertiary and dimmed tones on dark glass (the glass material) only (ADR-0022 §3)

on-glass-fill.$description: the scheme's glass (material.glass.fill and .chip): ink on light glass in light (ADR-0029 §1.3)

on-glass-fill-secondary.$description: secondary tone on the scheme's glass over Prism's map only (backdrop L >= 0.84; ADR-0029 §1.4)

on-glass-fill-tertiary.$description: tertiary tone on the scheme's glass over Prism's map only (ADR-0029 §1.4)

on-glass-fill-dimmed.$description: dimmed tone (trailing digits and units at >= 24 px) on the scheme's glass over Prism's map only (backdrop L >= 0.89; ADR-0029 §1.4)

on-glass-fill-media-secondary.$description: secondary tone on the scheme's glass over imagery and vivid: ink, the primary tone, in light (ADR-0029 §1.4)

on-glass-fill-media-tertiary.$description: tertiary and dimmed tones on the scheme's glass over imagery and vivid: ink in light (ADR-0029 §1.4)

accent.$description: 5.7:1 on page; the light accent is text-safe only at step 800
marks only, never text; 2.3:1 on white, so always paired with a value, sign or label (visual-dna B3)

strong.$description: outline controls such as the ghost button; ink 45% keeps 3:1 on surface and page (visual-dna B1)

on-media.$description: rings and outlines on vivid; decorative, next to a label or glyph (ADR-0030 §3.2)

on-glass-fill.$description: rings and outlines on the scheme's glass; decorative, next to a label or glyph (ADR-0030 §3.2)

highlight.$description: the glass edge, drawn at the recipe's edge.start and edge.end alphas, and the vivid highlight at material.vivid.edge.* (ADR-0030 §4.1, §4.2)

raised.$description: the 1 px top edge of raised: the puffy chip (ADR-0030 §4.1)

$root.$description: marks: dots, chart 'now', peak ticks, delta glyph fill; 2.3:1 on white, so a mark always sits with its value, sign or label, and a mark that alone carries meaning uses accent.700 (4.8:1; visual-dna B3)

comparison.$description: comparison line; ink 45% keeps 3:1 on the plot, the boundary tier of chart lines that carry meaning (ADR-0011; ink 30% was 2.0:1, critic G-14)

target.$description: the mandatory target line (ADR-0007 rule 2); ink 60% (5.07:1 on white) reads above comparison's 45% (ADR-0030 §2.4)

now.$description: the now marker; 2.3:1 on white, so it always carries its label or value (visual-dna B3)

plot.$description: charts never sit on raw glass

reference.$description: the target or reference line on vivid, told apart from the line by stroke.target's dash (ADR-0030 §2.2; ADR-0007 rule 2)

plot.$description: the plot on the scheme's glass: a white 8% lift, not a white hole (ADR-0030 §2.3)

line.$description: chart line on the scheme's glass: the glass foreground, ink in light (ADR-0030 §2.3)

reference.$description: the target or reference line on the scheme's glass (ADR-0030 §2.3; ADR-0007 rule 2)

land.$description: map ground: the land, the page (ADR-0030 §1.1)

block.$description: map ground: city blocks, over the land

building.$description: map ground: buildings, over the land

road.$description: map ground: roads; a major road is road at a wider stroke over road-casing (ADR-0030 §1.3)

road-casing.$description: map ground: the casing under roads

water.$description: map ground: water, over the land; hue never carries status on the map (ADR-0030 §1.2)

park.$description: map ground: parks, over the land

label.$description: map labels, with a halo of color.map.land at 2 x border.strong (ADR-0030 §1.4); functional on every ground

route.$description: the ridden route, 2 x chart.line-width over route-casing (ADR-0030 §1.4)

route-ahead.$description: the route ahead, 1.5 x chart.line-width, dashed with stroke.target (ADR-0030 §1.4)

route-casing.$description: the casing under the route lines, 3.5 x chart.line-width (ADR-0030 §1.4)

$root.$description: the scheme's glass: Surface glass and Card glass over maps, imagery and vivid; aliases glass.light.fill field by field (ADR-0029 §1.2)
the scheme's glass for chips, controls and status cells over media; aliases glass.light.chip field by field (ADR-0029 §1.2)
card or drawer over a photo or vivid, on backdrops where white holds 3:1 (ADR-0022 §3.3); drawer 0.35
controls over a photo, map or vivid; primary foreground text.on-glass only (ADR-0022 §3)
chips, pills, rows over vivid; tab bar 0.45; ink text (text.on-glass-light); only over vivid or imagery at OKLCH L >= 0.45 (ADR-0022)
status cells over a render or vivid; smoked fill, primary foreground text.on-glass only; a 1.5 px status border carries the status (ADR-0022)

scrim.$description: bottom-up under text on unpredictable backdrops: large white text holds 3:1 over it on pure white (ADR-0029 §1.7); maps need no scrim

start.$description: alpha of color.edge.highlight at the start of a vivid surface's 1 px inner edge (ADR-0030 §4.2)

end.$description: alpha of color.edge.highlight at the end of a vivid surface's inner edge (ADR-0030 §4.2)

gradient.$description: Scheme-safe slots over the brand's vivid gradients; each resolves to a gradient of this scheme (ADR-0024 §6).

default.$description: the unset vivid of Card and Surface: sky in the light scheme (ADR-0022 §4.4)

1.$description: slot pair 1 + 2 is one temperature: a vivid 2x2 alternates the pair on its diagonals (ADR-0029 §2.5)

3.$description: slot pair 3 + 4 is one temperature: a vivid 2x2 alternates the pair on its diagonals (ADR-0029 §2.5)
